verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Llama weights can be downloaded and run locally on desktop, mobile and edge runtimes, but nothing documents telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control for Llama's tools (e.g. the llama-models CLI) or Meta-hosted surfaces. Local execution is an adjacent deployment property, not a documented telemetry opt-out capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
